tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: List projects currently owned by the authenticated user. No model, director or credential configuration is returned.

tools.name: read_project_summary
tools.description: Read safe project metadata, aspect ratio and current content counts.

tools.name: read_canvas
tools.description: Read live canvas metadata and CAS versions, 20 nodes by default (max 40). includeDrafts=true returns complete editable drafts and requires limit <=6. Use read_artifacts for immutable content/pixels.

tools.name: read_artifacts
tools.description: Read 1–12 exact immutable versions from the selected project. Text is bounded; at most one controlled image preview per call. No paths or download URLs.

tools.name: create_text
tools.description: Create a text artifact and canvas node atomically. Retry lost responses with the identical commandId and arguments.

tools.name: revise_artifact
tools.description: Append a text version using artifact expectedVersion. Locked nodes and archived media cannot be revised. A replay returns the original version before checking current CAS.

tools.name: manage_canvas_node
tools.description: Rename, move or resize one node using its layout expectedVersion. This never modifies content versions. Locked nodes reject changes.

tools.name: create_media_node
tools.description: Create an empty IMAGE/VIDEO/AUDIO artifact, canvas node and draft. This does not call a Provider.

tools.name: update_media_draft
tools.description: Patch the persisted media draft using independent expectedDraftVersion. Arrays replace complete inputs/mentions; omitted fields keep previous values. Explicit mediaInputs reconcile reference connections. Does not generate.

tools.name: list_media_capabilities
tools.description: List enabled published media capabilities and safe input contracts. No connection addresses, credentials or raw executable workflows.

tools.name: run_media
tools.description: Immediately accept media generation without a fee approval. Pins the draft and exact inputs, returning ALL charged Task outputs. Other commands occupying the node cause CANVAS_ITEM_BUSY. Keep commandId stable on retry; a new command is a new delegation.

tools.name: read_task_status
tools.description: Read same-project task states and exact result references. UNKNOWN remains UNKNOWN; this query never retries generation or wakes an internal Agent.
